Append-only history: repairs, notes, custody/location moves, and status transitions (RECALLED/DECOMMISSIONED — the only way a unit leaves REGISTERED). A professional currently scanned in via POST /serialized-units/:code/scan may also call this, but only for NOTE/REPAIR events. NOTE: OSPI receives this data — the scan-and-log UI itself lives in each professional's own software; a client SDK for this flow is a planned follow-up, not yet built.
